additive_runtime_objects: event-snapshot-v1: account, scope, canonical-version-bound incremental baseline with per-UID sequence state
calendar-export-v1: iCalendar, Markdown and structured summary exports
opaque evc1 cursor: account/scope-bound, 600-second expiry, process-local, no timestamp breakpoint
outputs: stable event_uid from account, service, kind, source record and occurrence; title and array order never participate
deadline, interval and occurrence time semantics separated; date-only values stay DATE and never gain midnight
undated agenda items keep calendar_valid=false; export refuses them instead of inventing a date
views for upcoming, overdue, undated, completed and by_source computed from one as_of instant
conflicts only for trusted DATE_TIME intervals; all-day, deadline points, unknown times and timetable entries without a period table never participate
incremental change types ADDED/MODIFIED/CANCELLED/DELETED/SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE
deletions only when the previous and current source reads are both complete; failed or partial pages carry prior events forward as HISTORICAL
agenda() collects every snapshot page and fails closed with AGENDA_RESULT_TRUNCATED beyond 50 pages instead of returning a truncated OK
academic events are filtered by the requested window before agenda()/changes() expose them
per-UID sequence and semantic digest keep iCalendar SEQUENCE monotonic across baseline rebuild, scope change and the no-key in-process path
export_calendar() is a pure local write that never reads a source or advances the incremental baseline; export_agenda() is the explicit read-then-export path
iCalendar RFC 5545 escaping, UTF-8-safe 75-octet folding, Asia/Shanghai VTIMEZONE and date-level DTSTART for all-day deadlines
stable UID, sequence and STATUS:CANCELLED for repeatable import/update of the same event
Markdown and JSON exports with sanitised fields, https-only source links, formula/table/HTML/path injection neutralised
atomic local writes via temporary file, fsync and hard-link/O_EXCL claim; a failed write leaves no half file and a racing destination is refused
explicit scope required; out-of-scope events are counted as excluded, never silently exported
academics exams/timetable are opt-in and capability-gated; blocked capabilities return UNKNOWN/ADAPTER_REQUIRED, never EMPTY
grades are not a selectable agenda source and never become todos or public summary events
get_todos keeps its legacy parameters, 200-item snapshot paging, cursor binding and empty/partial/failed semantics
agenda()/changes()/export_calendar()/export_agenda()/describe_agenda() expose on-demand results with background_polling=false and message_delivery=false

verified_cases: the same snapshot compared twice produces no semantic changes and deterministic change ids
a disconnected source emits SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, keeps prior events HISTORICAL and never reports them all as deleted
a partial page emits SOURCE_INCOMPLETE and suppresses deletion until two complete reads agree
an incomplete previous baseline cannot make a deletion
academic events outside the requested window are absent from agenda() and changes()
an agenda with more than one snapshot page returns every item instead of a silent 200-item cut
a pure export performs zero source reads and leaves the incremental baseline unchanged
SEQUENCE does not reset after baseline expiry, a scope change or a no-key in-process run
a cross-midnight reservation keeps 23:00-01:00 in Asia/Shanghai and the original export scope
a date-only deadline exports DTSTART;VALUE=DATE and no midnight time or DTEND
a title with semicolons, commas, newlines, backslashes and script characters is escaped and folded without breaking VEVENT structure
the same event exported twice has the same UID; a semantic change raises SEQUENCE and a cancellation keeps STATUS:CANCELLED
two same-title items from different sources keep distinct event_uids
grades are rejected as a service selection and are absent from ACADEMIC_SOURCES
a blocked academics capability is opt-in only, returns UNKNOWN/ADAPTER_REQUIRED with PARTIAL status, and is never read
all-day, unknown-time and period-table-missing timetable items do not participate in conflicts
an invalid end before start is excluded instead of becoming an invented interval
scope, canonical-version and account changes rebuild or reject the baseline instead of comparing across it
the cursor is opaque, versioned, account/scope-bound, process-local and expires after the configured TTL
no change or result records delivered_at, pushed=true or delivery_evidence=true
an atomic write failure leaves no temporary or half file; a racing destination is refused
Markdown neutralises leading formula characters, HTML tags and table separators
incomplete sources reject an export unless allow_partial is passed, and then the file header says source_complete=false
all 29 new 5.4 error codes are registered in the frozen contract and the source_state mirror
limits: Personal timetable, exam and grade production adapters remain BLOCKED_SOURCE_EVIDENCE; this module only gates and converts them, and no real academic record was read.
Timetable events require explicit expansion from the 4.1 reader; the production reader is blocked, so only the synthetic path is covered here.

The outer THU-TODOS-1 cache container and record_id-in-AAD migration were not changed; like the 4.4 THU-ACTION-1 boundary this remains a later storage/integration step, and the existing cache format stays readable.
SnapshotStore prefers the 2.2 SecureStore EVENT_CURSOR purpose; without a usable key it keeps an in-process baseline and never writes plaintext.
Cross-process incremental continuation requires a configured secure key; otherwise cursors remain valid only in the current process.
iCalendar has no UNKNOWN status, so STATUS:UNKNOWN is exported as TENTATIVE plus X-OPENTHU-CALENDAR-STATUS:UNKNOWN; this is not a success claim.
Exports write only to an explicit absolute path whose parent exists; existing files require overwrite=true and symbolic-link targets are refused.
Pending approval, pending payment, upload success and draft state must not become confirmed agenda entries; 6.1 and the write adapters keep that rule.
rollback: Restore events.py, snapshot_diff.py, calendar_export.py, tests/test_events.py and tests/test_calendar_export.py from 37b1605 (delete the new files); restore todos.py to 37b1605; revert the 5.4 error codes in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json and source_state.py. The new get_todos parameters are optional and old callers ignore them; existing todo snapshots and cache format are unchanged. The events-v1 snapshot directory is separate from the legacy cache; invalidate new cursors explicitly on rollback. User-exported local calendar files are never deleted or remotely revoked.
